intro.text: A lighthouse keeper in a small port village in eastern Roshar.

items.text: After the Everstorm hit his coastal town, Puuli mourned the damage with his neighbours and pitched in with the clean-up and minding children, all the while gathering scrap wood for his lighthouse, which he called Defiance.

Secretly, Puuli was glad the storm had come. His grandfather had told him of lost sailors on a hidden island near the Origin, who would return when the night was darkest to reclaim Natanatan, and he believed the storm signalled a time of change.

appearance.text: A squat, short Natan man with blue skin and white hair.

personality.text: Hard-working and traditional, he is unimpressed by how rich people spend their money. He is friendly with nearly everyone in town, though he sometimes hides what he feels. He worships Kelek, leaving him fruit, and believes he lives in the highstorm.
